# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant v2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

## Our Pledge

We pledge to make participation in this project a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size,
disability, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, level of experience, nationality, appearance, race, religion, or
sexual identity and orientation.

## Our Standards

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment: being respectful of differing viewpoints, giving and
gracefully accepting constructive feedback, and focusing on what is best for the community.

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, and publishing others' private
information without permission.

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behavior to the maintainer through a private
[security advisory](https://github.com/edycutjong/portaldot-hackathon-2026-airlock-edycu/security/advisories/new) or the
contact on the maintainer's GitHub profile (@edycutjong). All reports are reviewed and answered. The full text of the
Covenant applies: https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/
